rows.Kwic: 謂具三玄三要者，覿體全真；謂分五位君臣者，宛轉回互。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Shixi Xinyue (石溪心月禪師語錄): in his Bao'en Monastery small address, Shixi Xinyue contrasts the three mysteries and essentials with the five lord-minister positions.
